name: ensoniqplaydetect
description: ensoniqplay(1) M3 raw signedness autodetect: a raw 8-bit SIGNED file (0.5 s silence at 0x00 + 0.5 s low-amplitude signed tone, 22050 Hz) is played with -a.  Its histogram mode is 0x00 (the silence), which sits at a code edge, so the detector picks signed -- proving -a keys on the quiet level.  '(detected)' + 'signed' confirm the choice; playing it correctly (silence -> DOC $80) and halting after ~60 ticks (22050 samples at 22050 Hz = 1.0 s) confirm the sign conversion.
